topic: Commissioning delays and Shell LNG-supply deferral
wiki_text: Although the Tema LNG Terminal Company's FSU 'Vasant 1' and floating regasification unit ('Torman') have been moored at the Port of Tema since 2021-2022 and Reganosa was contracted to operate the terminal, the facility has not entered sustained commercial gas supply. Shell, the long-term LNG supplier, signed a deferral amendment with GNPC and TLTC postponing LNG shipments by roughly two years to avoid near-term take-or-pay fiscal burden on Ghana. As of mid-2025 the project had not come online (the IGU 2025 World LNG Report listed its start year as 2025), and analysts (ACEP/IMANI) flagged contingent liabilities of up to US$1.5 billion under the take-or-pay structure. The operating consortium maintains the terminal is 'operational,' but no confirmed first commercial regasification cargo has been documented.
